name: inputData
label: inputData
description: Array of objects to be sorted. One property of the object should be called 'properties' and is a key-value mapping of a column and display value to sort.

name: sortCategoriesArray
label: sortCategoriesArray
description: Array of objects of columns to sort on. The object should have a (translated) 'label' and 'id' property. The id must be the keys of objects from inputData.
